title: Pawn Promotion
summary: Reach the far end of the board and transform your pawn!

steps.text: When a pawn reaches the very last rank (rank 8 for White, rank 1 for Black), something magical happens — it PROMOTES! It transforms into any piece you want, except a king — almost always a queen, since she's the strongest.
Black's pawns promote too — but on the opposite end, rank 1!

steps.prompt: Push your pawn all the way to e8 to promote it into a queen!
steps.successText: New queen! Pawns can become the most powerful piece on the board.
steps.retryText: Push the pawn forward to the last rank, e8, to promote it.

steps.prompt: You can promote AND capture at the same time! Capture the rook on e8 and turn your pawn into a queen.
steps.successText: Double win — captured a rook AND got a new queen!
steps.retryText: Capture the rook on e8 as your pawn promotes.

steps.text: You don't have to promote to a queen — you could choose a rook, bishop, or knight instead, though a queen is almost always best. Next: let's learn about draws — when nobody wins!
